content:
deploy-bot: Hotpatch image available: registry.redwood/inference/session-muxer:hotpatch-2026-03-24-ea77
deploy-bot: Initiating canary in dedicated-apac1 (4% -> 25% ramp). Monitor window 9m. UI: https://console.redwood/releases/ea77

hazel: multiple Dedicated tenants reported stuck sessions last hour; this patch reduces session hold timeout and tightens accept loop. Thanks team.

marco: curious if tightening timeouts could surface client disconnect churn. any mitigation?

infra-lee: added a reconnect jitter and a short soft-drain window to reduce thundering reconnects. Load tests show connection churn down 40%.

ops-lead: set rollback criteria up front: rollback if errors > 2% sustained 3m OR p95 > 1.4s for 4m OR reconnect_rate > +30% over baseline for 5m. Also manual rollback on customer 500 spikes.

release-manager: expedited approval checklist: ops-lead + infra-lee + oncall-jordan. I'll publish a quick customer note once we hit 50%.

oncall-jordan: on call and watching dashboards. +1. I can trigger rollback if I see restart churn.

infra-lee: +1 after code review; no infra config changes. small code delta.

ops-lead: +1. Given Dedicated impact, prefer staged promote with manual thumbs.

marco: running canary: ```/deploy canary --svc session-muxer --image registry.redwood/inference/session-muxer:hotpatch-2026-03-24-ea77 --canary 4% --to 25% --monitor 9m```

deploy-bot: Canary started -> stepping 4% -> 25%. Posting periodic snapshots.

(deploy-bot update) 3309990009: canary snapshot: errors 1.0%, p95 810ms, qps 270, reconnect_rate +8%, restarts 0

hazel: logs show accept timeouts down significantly. good early sign.

marco: recommend manual promote to 50% for a short soak (10m) then thumbs to 100%.

ops-lead: agree. infra-lee, oncall-jordan stay ready.

marco: promoting to 50% now: ```/deploy promote --svc session-muxer --to 50% --wait 10m```

deploy-bot: Promotion started -> target 50% traffic. ETA ~2m.

(deploy-bot update) 3309990018: promotion complete. final metrics: errors 0.6%, p95 720ms, reconnect_rate +4%, restarts 0. All green.

release-manager: Published ephemeral release note and pinged CS lead. Draft: "Session muxer hotpatch: session timeout tuning and reconnect jitter to mitigate stuck sessions for Dedicated pools. Rolling now."

ops-lead: good work. Keep rollback playbook open for 45m. If any Dedicated tenant reports regression, oncall to execute sequence rollback and infra to revert image pin.

hazel: thanks all 44d will follow up with a short post-deploy blameless note and close once 24h stable.
